text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! I never imagined you'd be this 
good at it!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
If it were up to me, I'd love to go for 
seconds too, but I don't think I can carry 
any more than this.
choice_data_list:
Here, you can have it—you're collecting 
them, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Really!? All of this? Yay! I'm so happy.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I promise, Trainer. I'll make sure to 
treasure each and every one of them!
